workflow.name: Threads Video Downloader & Google Drive Logger
workflow.description: Accepts a Threads URL via web form; fetches video metadata from the RapidAPI Threads Downloader; downloads the video file; uploads it to Google Drive with public sharing; logs the result (URL + Drive link or N/A) to Google Sheets. Failed downloads are logged after a brief wait.

RAPIDAPI_KEY.description: RapidAPI key for Threads Downloader API (mocked)

GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID.description: Google Drive folder ID for video uploads (mocked — saved locally)

GOOGLE_SHEETS_DOC_ID.description: Google Sheets document ID for logging (mocked — saved to local CSV)

workflow_steps.name: On form submission
workflow_steps.description: User submits a Threads URL via the Threads Downloader web form

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Threads Video Data
workflow_steps.description: POST the URL to threads-downloader1.p.rapidapi.com to retrieve video metadata and download URLs

workflow_steps.name: Check If Video Exists
workflow_steps.description: Verify video_urls[0].download_url is not empty; found → step 4, not found → step 8

workflow_steps.name: Download Threads Video File
workflow_steps.description: Download the video binary from the API-provided URL

workflow_steps.name: Upload Video to Google Drive
workflow_steps.description: Upload the downloaded video file to the configured Google Drive folder
